features.title: Monorepo layout
features.summary: Smart_QR_UI holds the product; smart-qr-dev-doc is this documentation Angular app.
features.content:
## Layout

- **Smart_QR_UI** — customer-facing Smart QR application (NgModule-based).
- **smart-qr-dev-doc** — internal docs (standalone components, JSON under `assets/content`).

Clone once; open the folder you need for `npm install` and `ng serve`.

features.title: Routing entry
features.summary: All product routes are declared in app-routing.module.ts.
features.content:
## app-routing.module.ts

Central place for lazy-ish route wiring: QR list, per-type wizards (`/qr-codes/type/...`), edit flows, viewers, admin subtree, auth, analytics.

When adding a screen, register the path here and place components under `pages/systematic/modules/`.

features.title: qr-code.service central hub
features.summary: Large service encapsulating SmartQRApi calls, QR generation, and loyalty/menu helpers.
features.content:
## qr-code.service.ts

Most HTTP calls to `{baseApiUrl}/SmartQRApi/...` live here. When debugging API issues, search this file for the action name (e.g. `SaveQR`, `GetLoyaltyRegistrations`).

features.title: Module tree under systematic
features.content:
## modules/

- **qr-code-list** — QR CRUD, wizards, viewers, loyalty, shops configuration.
- **admin** — users, roles, QR admin, email templates.
- **auth** — login, forgot/set password.
- **analytics** — usage dashboards.
- **settings** — user-facing settings.

features.title: Shared UI
features.summary: Reusable pieces under shared/ for previews, filters, and content tabs.
features.content:
## shared/

Contains cross-feature widgets (e.g. menu preview frames, content section editors). Prefer reusing these before adding duplicate templates in a feature module.

features.title: Environment and API base
features.summary: baseApiUrl points at your Smart QR backend (local or UAT).
features.content:
## environment.ts

`baseApiUrl` must match a running API instance. `baseAdminUrl` is used where the UI needs its own origin. Align with DevOps for staging vs production URLs.

features.title: Naming conventions
features.summary: PascalCase components, camelCase in TS, QRType routes kebab-case.
features.content:
## Conventions

- Angular components: `SomethingComponent` + `something.component.ts`.
- API DTOs from backend often arrive PascalCase; UI code may map to camelCase.
- Route segments use kebab-case (`/qr-codes/type/loyalty-program`).

features.title: Guards at a glance
features.summary: AuthGuard and AdminGate restrict routes; detailed docs in Smart QR — Auth domain.
features.content:
## Guards

`AuthGuard` protects authenticated areas. `AdminGuard` restricts admin modules. See **Smart QR — Auth** for storage keys (`authToken`, `userId`, etc.).
